title: Scheff Zello
summary: Zello push-to-talk: hold Space to talk on your Zello channels
description: A Zello push-to-talk client. Sign in to zello.io or a Zello Work network, pick a channel, and hold Space to talk; incoming voice plays as it arrives, and channel text messages can be read and sent. Set it up on the device or from a browser on the same network (port 8960). Uses the system's default audio devices, so a USB headset with a microphone works and can be plugged in while it runs. fn+S/D sets the volume, fn+U/I the brightness; hold Esc for 3 seconds to quit.
